newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU clears Smart city car distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: EU clears Smart city car distribution deal.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it had approved an amended standard distribution agreement of MC Micro Compact car AG (MCC) covering the sale and servicing of the two-seater Smart city car.
MCC is a joint venture company of Daimler-Benz and Societe Suisse de Microelectronique et d'Horlogerie SA.
Following several amendments, MCC submitted in April an altered distribution contract which were in line with EU legislation, the Commission said in a statement.

For example, the contract complied with EU rules as Smart car dealers are allowed to market different makes and as they may sell spare parts which compete with contract goods if they are of matching quality, it added.
The Commission said it had sent an administrative letter informing MCC that the latest version of the agreement was in conformity with EU rules.
